name: MIT Spring 2011

venue.name: [Massachusetts Institute of Technology](http://www.mit.edu)
venue.details: Lobdell Dining Room, second floor of Stratton Student Center

information: Competitors who pre-register by February 26 will pay a $5 fee at the door.  Starting February 27, this fee will raise $2 per day up to a maximum of $15.  Competitors who do not pre-register will be charged $15 and may only compete in 2 events.  $1 from each registration will go to the WCA for server costs.
